contract: RAVIS skill store, for NERVIS's Skills page
about: RAVIS 0.28.0 and NERVIS 0.33.0. NERVIS's alone: Clarvis never calls these routes, so this fixture lives beside relay-contract/, not in it, and Clarvis's manifest doesn't cover it.
Errors use the MEP envelope; clients match on code and details, and the page shows message, which is written for the owner.

Implemented by ravis/src/ravis/api/management/skill_store.py over agent/skill_installs.py, agent/skill_market.py, agent/skill_package.py, agent/skill_github.py, agent/skill_sites.py and agent/skill_web.py.
decisions: Owner, 15 September 2026: install a skill from a GitHub link to a skill folder or from a zip file, and never before a review: name, description, license, the file list with scripts flagged, and SKILL.md's text.
Installed skills arrive switched off for Codex and for the other models until the owner switches them on. Skills copied into NERVIS's skills folder by hand stay on, as before.
Update reviews what changed first and is never automatic. Remove moves the folder to the macOS Trash; nothing is deleted.

A marketplace: anthropics/skills, openai/skills (deprecated by its owner), ComposioHQ/awesome-claude-skills, the VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills link list, skills.sh's search, and the owner's own GitHub repositories, link lists and websites with an Agent Skills index.
agentskills.io is the rules installs are checked against (its specification), and its discovery standard is how a website becomes a source.

access.reads: GET /api/v1/skills/installs and GET /api/v1/skills/market: NERVIS's client credential (its GET relay) or an admin credential; never Clarvis
access.writes: every POST: an admin credential (NERVIS's Skills page, through its control routes)

specification: name: 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen, no two hyphens together, and the same as the skill's folder name
description: 1-1024 characters; license and allowed-tools: text; compatibility: 1-500 characters; metadata: a mapping
other front matter fields, metadata values that aren't text and a SKILL.md over 500 lines are warnings, never refusals
package: paths stay inside the skill: relative, no empty, . or .. part, no backslash, no control character, at most 10 folders deep
no symbolic or hard links, no special files, no encrypted zip entries, no git submodules
macOS's __MACOSX folder and .DS_Store files are left out and counted in a warning
one skill per archive: SKILL.md at the top, or inside one folder at the top
a file's kind is skill_md; script (by extension, a #! first line or an executable bit); binary (not UTF-8); or text
network: https only; GitHub sources, link lists and skills.sh results fetch only from github.com, api.github.com, codeload.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com; skills.sh's search only from skills_sh_url's host; a website only from the host the owner added
redirects are followed only within the same call's hosts, at most five
connect 5 s, between bytes 20 s, 60 s in all; answers capped by size while streaming
no credential is ever sent, and the environment (netrc, proxies) isn't trusted
a rate-limited host gets nothing more until the time it said; GitHub's remaining allowance is read from its answers
rules.install: Refused when anything is already at <skills folder>/<name>. Both switches are written off before the folder appears; the staged folder moves in in one step; the install is recorded. A repeated confirm of the same preview answers what the first did.
rules.update: Fetched from where the skill came from: a GitHub install's repository folder at its branch or tag (the default branch when none), a website's index (compared by digest), or a new zip file for a zip install. Both switches go off when SKILL.md changed or a script was added or changed; otherwise they are kept, and the review says which. Refused when the installed folder changed after the review. The earlier version goes to the Trash.
rules.remove: Only a skill RAVIS installed; never a skill put in the folder by hand, a personal skill or a built-in one. Its folder moves to ~/.Trash/<name> <YYYY-MM-DD HH.MM.SS> (numbered when taken), then both switches and the record go. Refused, changing nothing, when the folder can't be moved there.
rules.installed: A marketplace entry is installed when RAVIS installed a skill from the same GitHub repository folder, or the same website under the same name.

routes.needs: NERVIS's client credential or an admin credential
routes.answer: Installs {folder, installs: [{name, path, source, installed_at, updated_at, content_hash, present, changed_on_this_mac}]}
rules: path is the real path of the installed skill's SKILL.md, the same path GET /api/v1/skills lists it by
source is {origin: github, repository, folder, ref, commit, via, url}, {origin: website, site, index, digest, via} or {origin: zip}
present: the folder is still there; changed_on_this_mac: its files differ from what was installed

routes.needs: NERVIS's client credential or an admin credential
rules: fetches nothing: every listing is what the last refresh or resolve kept

Source: {id, kind: github | link_list | search | website, label, repository, folders, path, ref, site, default, deprecated, uncurated, note, hidden, fetched_at, stale, problem, count}; stale is true when the listing is missing or older than a day, never for search
Entry: {id, source, state: ready | unresolved | problem | not_installable, name, description, license, label, problem, lives_in, repository, folder, ref, site, link, installed, install}
install is the body of POST /api/v1/skills/previews that reviews the entry, or null when it can't be installed here
a hidden source lists no entries
a GitHub source lists at most 300 skills (50 at one link): the folders nearest the top first, then alphabetically; when some are left out, problem says how many (0.28.1)

sources.label: anthropics/skills
sources.note: Some skills carry their own license terms: read each one's license.

routes.body: {origin: github, url} | {origin: github, repository, folder?, ref?} | {origin: github, repository, skill} | {origin: website, source, name}; github bodies may carry via, a source id
routes.answer: Preview {preview_id, expires_at, kind: install | update, name, description, license: {text, from: front_matter | file | null}, compatibility, source, files: [{path, bytes, kind}], skill_md, warnings: [{code, message}], checked_against, arrives_switched_off, update}
rules: fetches and checks the skill and stages it in RAVIS's own data folder, never the skills folder; nothing is installed
url is a github.com link to a folder (tree/), a SKILL.md (blob/) or a repository; skill finds the shallowest folder of that name holding a SKILL.md
kind is update when RAVIS already installed a skill of that name from the same place; update is then {changes: {added, removed, changed, skill_md_diff}, switches: reset | kept, why}, else null
warning codes: has_scripts, clashes_with_installed, clashes_with_personal, unknown_fields, metadata_not_text, long_skill_md, left_out
a preview lives 15 minutes; at most five wait, the oldest discarded first

rules: 409 SKILL_NOT_UPDATABLE for a zip install, which updates from a new zip through POST /api/v1/skills/previews/zip; 404 SKILL_NOT_INSTALLED for a skill RAVIS didn't install

rules: reads every shown source (or the one named) whose listing is a day old, or all of them when force is true; a source that can't be read keeps its last listing and its problem says why

routes.body: {source: a link list's id, links: [1-50 of its links]}
routes.answer: Market, as GET /api/v1/skills/market, with note: null or why some links weren't looked up
rules: at most 10 links looked up per call, each kept a day; stops, with note, when GitHub rate-limits RAVIS or its hourly allowance is down to 10

routes.answer: {source: skills_sh, query, note, results: [{name, skill, repository, installs, installed, install}], problem}
rules: results come most installed first; any failure of skills.sh is problem, in plain words, with 200 and no results
a query shorter than 2 characters is never sent to skills.sh, which refuses one: problem is "skills.sh needs a search of at least 2 letters." (0.28.1)
when skills.sh refuses a search (HTTP 400), problem gives its own words: "skills.sh refused the search: …" (0.28.1)
a query's results are kept in RAVIS's memory 5 minutes, whatever its letter case, so the same words don't ask skills.sh again; installed is worked out on every answer (0.28.1)
source in skills.sh's answer comes in lower case; GitHub reads a repository's name in any case, and the skill's folder is found whatever its case (0.28.1)

routes.body: {kind: github, repository, path?, ref?} | {kind: link_list, repository, path? (default README.md), ref?} | {kind: website, url}
rules: 409 MARKET_SOURCE_EXISTS for the same source twice; 409 MARKET_SOURCES_FULL past 30 of the owner's own
any source, RAVIS's own included
only the owner's own; 409 MARKET_SOURCE_IS_DEFAULT for RAVIS's own, which can be hidden

carries: the zip file's bytes, at most 8 MB

audit.rule: never a file's contents; every event also carries request_id and application_id
